title: LLM Provider Configuration
subtitle: Choose between 100% local inference (LM Studio) or cloud API (OpenRouter BYOK)

provider.label: Inference Provider
provider.lmstudioDesc: 100% Private and Offline on your machine
provider.openrouterDesc: Access DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, Llama with your own API key

openrouter.apiKeyHelp: Your key is stored exclusively in your browser (localStorage). It is never sent to intermediate servers.
openrouter.customModelPlaceholder: Or type a model ID (e.g., deepseek/deepseek-chat)...

connection.endpointHelp: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API running in LM Studio, Ollama, or LocalAI.
connection.corsWarningText: Ensure LM Studio is running with Local Server active and that 'Enable CORS' is checked in LM Studio server settings.

parameters.temperatureHelp: Lower values (0.1 - 0.3) provide more consistent, literal, and accurate translations.
parameters.batchSizeHelp: Number of subtitle cues processed in a single LLM request (recommended: 8 to 15).
parameters.maxTokensHelp: Maximum token limit for the model completion.

prompt.systemPromptHelp: Base instructions sent to the model to define its role, tone, and formatting constraints.
